common_property_schema.name: file_extension
common_property_schema.label: File Extension
common_property_schema.help: Default file extension for output files (without the dot). Common extensions: nc, gcode, tap, ngc, sbp, etc.

common_property_schema.name: supports_tool_radius_compensation
common_property_schema.label: Tool Radius Compensation (G41/G42)
common_property_schema.help: Enable if this postprocessor supports G41/G42 tool radius compensation commands. When enabled, the postprocessor can output cutter compensation codes.

common_property_schema.name: supported_commands
common_property_schema.label: Supported G-code Commands
common_property_schema.help: List of G-code commands supported by this postprocessor (one per line). Commands not in this list will be filtered out or cause warnings.

common_property_schema.name: ignored_commands
common_property_schema.label: Ignore G-code Commands
common_property_schema.help: List of G-code commands, tolerated but ignored by this post-processor (one per line). Commands in this list will be filtered out.

common_property_schema.name: drill_cycles_to_translate
common_property_schema.label: Drill Cycles to Translate
common_property_schema.help: List of drill cycle commands to translate to G0/G1 moves (one per line). Standard drill cycles: G73, G81, G82, G83, G85. Leave empty if postprocessor supports drill cycles natively.

common_property_schema.name: preamble
common_property_schema.label: Preamble
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted at the start of the program after the header.

common_property_schema.name: postamble
common_property_schema.label: Postamble
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted at the end of the program.

common_property_schema.name: safetyblock
common_property_schema.label: Safety Block
common_property_schema.help: Safety commands to reset machine to known safe condition (e.g., G40, G49, G80).

common_property_schema.name: pre_job
common_property_schema.label: Pre-Job
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted before each Job.

common_property_schema.name: post_job
common_property_schema.label: Post-Job
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted after each Job.

common_property_schema.name: pre_fixture_change
common_property_schema.label: Pre-Fixture
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted before fixture change.

common_property_schema.name: post_fixture_change
common_property_schema.label: Post-Fixture
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted after fixture change.

common_property_schema.name: pre_operation
common_property_schema.label: Pre-Operation
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted before each operation.

common_property_schema.name: post_operation
common_property_schema.label: Post-Operation
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted after each operation.

common_property_schema.name: pre_tool_change
common_property_schema.label: Pre-Tool Change
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted before tool changes.

common_property_schema.name: post_tool_change
common_property_schema.label: Post-Tool Change
common_property_schema.help: G-code to execute immediately after a tool change (M6), before the spindle is turned on. Use for a custom tool length offset routine, custom cutter compensation, or a return motion before the spindle starts.

common_property_schema.name: tool_return
common_property_schema.label: Tool Return after tool changes
common_property_schema.help: G-code to execute immediately after the spindle is turned on after a tool change.

common_property_schema.name: pre_rotary_move
common_property_schema.label: Pre-Rotary Move
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted before the rotary axes move: before a rotary positioning move, and before a tilted work plane is declared when the control positions the axes itself. Put the moves that bring the tool clear of the part here, in machine coordinates (for example G53 G0 Z0); an operation's clearance height is measured in its own work plane and says nothing about the tool while the table turns.

common_property_schema.name: post_rotary_move
common_property_schema.label: Post-Rotary Move
common_property_schema.help: G-code commands inserted after the rotary axes have moved, and after a tilted work plane has been declared and aligned to.

common_property_schema.name: twp_control_positions_rotaries
common_property_schema.label: Tilted work plane: control positions the rotaries
common_property_schema.help: The plane command positions the rotary axes itself (G53.1, TURN). Off, the program commands them with a rotary move before declaring the plane.

common_property_schema.name: twp_declare
common_property_schema.label: Tilted work plane: declare
common_property_schema.help: The line that declares a tilted work plane, with {x} {y} {z} the plane's origin and {a1} {a2} {a3} the plane command's angles. Empty uses the plane command's own form.

common_property_schema.name: twp_align
common_property_schema.label: Tilted work plane: align
common_property_schema.help: The line that points the tool along a declared plane when the control positions the rotary axes itself. Empty uses the plane command's own form.

common_property_schema.name: twp_cancel
common_property_schema.label: Tilted work plane: cancel
common_property_schema.help: The line that cancels a declared plane. Empty uses the plane command's own form.

common_property_schema.name: show_dialog
common_property_schema.label: Show Pre-processing Dialogs
common_property_schema.help: Show interactive dialogs during post-processing. Disable for automated operation or testing.

common_property_schema.name: parameter_order
common_property_schema.label: Generated Parameter Order for GCode
common_property_schema.help: Generated Parameter Order for GCode for output

common_property_schema.name: output_tool_length_offset
common_property_schema.label: TLO after tool-change
common_property_schema.help: Output a G43 TLO after tool-change

common_property_schema.name: tool_change
common_property_schema.label: Allow tool-change
common_property_schema.help: Unchecked to suppress tool-change (M6)

common_property_schema.name: axis_precision
common_property_schema.label: Axis precision in output
common_property_schema.help: Decimals of precision for axis motion

common_property_schema.name: feed_precision
common_property_schema.label: Feedrate precision in output
common_property_schema.help: Decimals of precision for feedrate (F)

common_property_schema.name: spindle_decimals
common_property_schema.label: Spindle-speed precision in output
common_property_schema.help: Decimals of precision for spindle-speed

common_property_schema.name: f_for_rapid_moves
common_property_schema.label: Output F parameter for G0 (rapid)
common_property_schema.help: Whether to output the F parameter for G0 (rapid moves)

common_property_schema.name: translate_no_engagement_feed
common_property_schema.label: Output non-engaging moves at the no-engagement feed rate
common_property_schema.help: Certain G0's become G1 for operations that have "No-Engagement Feedrate"
